questions.stem: A scale bar on a micrograph shows that 10 mm on the image represents 5 micrometres. A cell in the image measures 30 mm. What is the actual size of the cell?
questions.explanation: If 10 mm represents 5 micrometres, then 1 mm represents 0.5 micrometres. The cell measuring 30 mm has an actual size of 30 x 0.5 = 15 micrometres.
